hero.bio: I'm a freelance web designer in Tilburg. There's no agency behind Noxta, just me. I do the design, write the copy, and write the code. After launch I stick around to fix things and add new ones as you need them. You email me, I email you back.

intro.label: 00 · Who I am
intro.sub: I work alone on purpose. Keeping the whole project in one head means nothing gets dropped between specialists who don't know your business as well as you do. The trade-off is capacity: I usually have two clients at a time, which is why slots are worth booking early.

servicesSection.label: 01 · What I do
servicesSection.sub: I handle the design, the copy, the code, and the payments myself. So there's no handoff between people who barely know each other, and if something breaks the person to call is me.

services.title: Websites
services.desc: Multi-page sites with SEO and analytics wired in from day one, not bolted on the week before launch.

services.title: E-commerce
services.desc: Real shops with real payment flows. VOEP runs 4,200 SKUs on the setup I built.

services.title: Brand
services.desc: Wordmark, palette, and type system. Enough so the site looks like a brand, not a template.

services.title: Maintenance
services.desc: I stick around after launch. Updates, backups, and the small edits you'd usually be afraid to ask for.

cta.lede: Send me what you're working on and I'll come back within a day. If I can help, I'll quote you. If I can't, I'll tell you, and usually I know someone who can.

footer.bio: Adrian Tajti. A one-person studio in Tilburg. I work with small businesses, mostly Dutch and Belgian, who want a real person to call when something on their site needs changing.
